What Is HIPAA Compliance Software?

HIPAA compliance software is a centralized digital solution that streamlines your organization's compliance with the HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules. It serves as a task manager, training platform, document repository, and audit preparation toolkit, all in one easy-to-use platform.

Unlike generic software, our HIPAA solution is designed specifically for the healthcare industry ensuring nothing is missed when it comes to your legal obligations.

Core Features of Our HIPAA Compliance Software

Security Risk Assessments, Gap Analysis, and Remediation Tools

Every HIPAA-compliant organization must conduct an annual Security Risk Assessment (SRA). Our software walks you through the SRA, identifies gaps, and provides actionable remediation plans. You'll get a full view of your compliance status and what to address without hiring a consultant. Our compliance team is here to provide complete support and walk you through the steps as needed.

HIPAA Policies and Procedures Tailored to Your Practice

Our software includes customizable templates and tools to develop and manage HIPAA policies and procedures. Policies are mapped to the specific requirements of the HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules, with built-in support to adapt them to your practice.

Employee HIPAA Training and Tracking

Annual training is required—and our platform tracks it all. Easily assign HIPAA and cybersecurity training courses to employees, track completion, collect attestations, and send automated reminders. Never miss another training deadline.

Manage Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) in One Place

Vendors that interact with PHI must sign BAAs. Our HIPAA compliance software makes it easy to request, store, and track these agreements. You'll get BAA templates, renewal reminders, and documentation storage that simplifies due diligence and audits.

Incident Reporting and Breach Notifications

If an incident affects the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of PHI, it must be reported. Our platform enables anonymous internal reporting, alerts your compliance officer, and guides you through breach notification requirements.

Audit-Ready Reports and Documentation

In the event of an audit, our system generates clear, organized documentation that proves your compliance efforts. From SRAs to training records and BAAs, you'll be prepared with the reports you need.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How do I make my computer HIPAA compliant?

Use encrypted hard drives, install firewalls and antivirus software, apply regular security updates, enable automatic lock screens, and avoid using public Wi-Fi to access PHI. Our software provides device audits and endpoint security policies to help meet these standards.

What is the app that is HIPAA compliant?

Our HIPAA compliance software is a secure, cloud-based program designed specifically for healthcare organizations to manage HIPAA tasks, policies, and documentation. While we do not have an app for your iPhone or Android device, we are currently working on adding one.

Is Microsoft Teams a HIPAA compliant platform?

Microsoft Teams can be HIPAA compliant if configured correctly and if you sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with Microsoft. However, the platform alone does not ensure full HIPAA compliance.

Is ChatGPT HIPAA compliant?

As of now, ChatGPT is not HIPAA compliant and should not be used to process or store protected health information (PHI).

Is Google Drive HIPAA compliant?

Google Drive can be HIPAA compliant if it is part of Google Workspace for Healthcare and a signed BAA is in place. Configuration settings must also be adjusted for security.

What is required for software to be HIPAA compliant?

To be HIPAA compliant, software must include access controls, audit logs, encryption, secure user authentication, and ensure PHI is only accessed by authorized users. It must also support breach notification procedures and data integrity safeguards.

Is there an AI program that is HIPAA compliant?

Only AI solutions that have been purpose-built for healthcare and meet HIPAA safeguards including encryption, access control, and auditability can be considered HIPAA compliant. Currently, there are only two on the market that are marketed as HIPAA compliant with the utilization of Ai technology. At Healthcare Compliance Pros, we are continuing to follow updates in Ai technology as it pertains to the CDC and HHS.

Is Google Chat HIPAA compliant?

Google Chat can be HIPAA compliant with Google Workspace and a signed BAA, but it must be configured properly with restricted access and appropriate logging.

Is Zoom Healthcare HIPAA compliant?

Zoom for Healthcare is a HIPAA-compliant solution when a BAA is signed and proper security settings are implemented, including encryption and access control.
